title: Le prélèvement a été rejeté
setting: Lucioles Énergie, a fictional electricity supplier. The October direct debit of 142 € was returned by the bank on 20 Oct; the caller's letter mentions a possible cut-off.

turns.caller: Allô ? Bonjour… euh… j'ai reçu une lettre, le… le prélèvement, il est… rejected ? Et ça parle de coupure… Je sais pas comment on dit…

expected.draft_intent: Payment of 142 euros returned by the bank; nobody is cutting the electricity today; offer three monthly payments and a secure link for the first.

turns.caller: Pardon… plus lentement, s'il vous plaît ?

expected.draft_intent: Same as turn 1, re-said from the pre-rendered beginner cell with no draft and no render

turns.caller: Excusez-moi, je reprends. J'aurais souhaité comprendre pourquoi le prélèvement a été rejeté alors que le compte était approvisionné. Vous pouvez me parler normalement.

expected.draft_intent: Bank returned the debit on the 20th with a mandate-not-recognised code, usually a change of bank or account; the plan stands; the link takes the first instalment by card today; new mandate afterwards.

turns.caller: Parfait. Et on peut se tutoyer, hein, ce sera plus simple.

expected.draft_intent: First instalment received; the next two go through on the 5th of November and December; the electricity stays on.

expected.note: under five words: the judge returns can't-tell and changes nothing

renders_to_check: dates: the 5th of November and December at beginner
